scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package
scripts.docker:build:all: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm run build
scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm test
scripts.docker:lint: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm run lint
scripts.docker:package: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm run package
scripts.docker:ci: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm run ci
scripts.docker:php:test: docker compose run --rm toolbox composer test --working-dir=turbocommons-php
scripts.docker:ts:test: docker compose run --rm toolbox npm run test --prefix turbocommons-ts
